job.job_title: Lead - Software Developer - Agentic AI Development
job.job_description:
Job Summary

We're seeking an Agentic AI Developer to design, build, and maintain intelligent agent-based systems that interact with enterprise data and workflows. You'll work with our proprietary agentic framework, integrating enterprise systems via MCP servers and orchestrating multi-agent workflows powered by leading LLMs - deployed securely on AWS and hybrid environments.


Responsibilities

Design, implement, and optimize AI agent workflows within our in-house agentic framework
Integrate multiple LLMs (OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, etc.) into production pipelines
Develop and maintain enterprise connectors through MCP servers for secure data access
Build RAG pipelines - embeddings, vector search, and retrieval workflows for enterprise data
Build and deploy scalable microservices and APIs connecting AI agents with existing applications
Manage full lifecycle: development, versioning, deployment, and maintenance via GitHub, CI/CD, containers
Monitor model behavior, fine-tune prompts, and optimize cost-performance across LLM providers
Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure AI agents meet operational and compliance standards


Must-Have Skills

Programming: TypeScript - deep, hands-on expertise required
Strong software engineering fundamentals (Node.js a plus)
Agentic AI Frameworks: Hands-on experience with at least one: LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, or similar orchestration framework
Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, etc.) with prompt engineering best practices
AWS: Hands-on with AWS - Bedrock, S3, Lambda, and related cloud infrastructure
Containerization experience (Docker, Kubernetes)
MCP RAG Architecture: MCP server architecture for enterprise data integrations (REST, GraphQL, MongoDB, SQL)
Practical exposure to RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) - vector databases, embeddings, retrieval pipelines
Observability: Implement monitoring, tracing, logging, and observability for AI agents using Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, or similar


Good to Have

Experience with AWS Bedrock AgentCore
Experience with Claude Agent SDK
Evaluation: Design evaluation pipelines to measure agent quality, latency, hallucinations, and business outcomes
LLMOps: Experience with prompt versioning, evaluation, observability, cost optimization, and deployment
Frontend frameworks (React, Next.js) for agent dashboards/monitoring tools
DevOps workflows: GitHub Actions, Terraform
Prior experience building/maintaining multi-agent systems at enterprise scale
Contributions to open-source AI agentic projects or internal AI accelerators
Understanding of security, access management, and compliance for enterprise AI systems


Soft Skills

Strong analytical mindset and debugging ability
Proven collaboration across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, infra, product)
Curiosity-driven - stays current with fast-moving LLM and agent ecosystems
Excellent documentation and communication skills
